edits.before: "Construct macOS screencapture and AppleScript argument arrays without a shell. Pass typed text as an argument, never as executable script content. Read PNG dimensions from native screenshot headers and preserve the actual image payload. The default demo remains the fixture. Native capture requires an explicit --native-capture flag, OS permissions and a caller-supplied DESKTOP_SCALE when the display is scaled. Native click and typing are library methods, not automatic demo actions."
edits.after: "使用参数数组构造 macOS screencapture 和 AppleScript 调用，不经过 shell。把待输入文本作为参数传递，绝不能把它作为可执行脚本内容。读取原生截图头部中的 PNG 尺寸，并保留实际图像载荷。默认演示仍使用夹具。原生捕获必须显式提供 --native-capture、获得操作系统权限；显示缩放启用时，还需由调用方提供 DESKTOP_SCALE。原生点击和输入仅作为库方法提供，不是演示会自动执行的动作。"

edits.before: "The tests verify native argument construction and image metadata parsing. Native macOS execution is explicitly unverified by the fixture suite; use it only against a disposable test application."
edits.after: "测试校验原生参数构造和图像元数据解析；夹具测试明确不验证原生 macOS 执行，只应对可丢弃的测试应用尝试原生功能。"

edits.before: "Reject invalid input before the side effect."
edits.after: "在副作用发生前拒绝无效输入。"

edits.before: "Identifiers are unique, nonempty UTF-8 strings. Prompt changes alter dataset identity but do not change the ID's bucket."
edits.after: "标识符是唯一、非空的 UTF-8 字符串。提示词变化会改变数据集标识，但不改变该 ID 所属的桶。"

edits.before: "FNV-1a XORs each byte then multiplies modulo 2^32. The hash is independent of input arrival order."
edits.after: "FNV-1a 对每个字节异或，再乘法并按 2^32 取模；哈希不受输入到达顺序影响。"

edits.before: "The shard index is hash modulo shard count. Changing shard count requires a new run."
edits.after: "分片索引等于哈希对分片数取模，更改分片数需要新建运行。"

edits.before: "These buckets use the same FNV-1a 32 byte operations as the Go core, including UTF-8 inputs."
edits.after: "桶分配使用与 Go 核心相同的 FNV-1a 32 位字节操作，包括 UTF-8 输入。"

edits.before: "Every case belongs to exactly one bucket"
"Persist the lease before the worker starts"
edits.after: "工作进程启动前持久化租约"

edits.before: "The coordinator reloads the shared snapshot while holding the stable ledger lock."
edits.after: "协调器在持有稳定账本锁期间重新加载共享快照。"

edits.before: "An unfinished shard becomes claimable at the exact expiry boundary."
edits.after: "未完成的分片在准确的到期边界变为可领取。"

edits.before: "The replacement owner receives the next version, then the snapshot is saved before work begins."
edits.after: "接替者获得下一版本，并在工作开始之前保存快照。"

edits.before: "Old owns v1 until 110. Compute whether new can claim and which version becomes authoritative."
edits.after: "old 持有 v1，直到 110。计算 new 能否领取，以及哪个版本将成为当前有效版本。"
"重新交付只确认同一份证据"

edits.before: "An old lease cannot write even if its answer is correct."
edits.after: "即使答案正确，旧租约也无法写入。"

edits.before: "An identical completed receipt is acknowledged without reopening the shard."
edits.after: "确认完全相同的已完成凭据，不重新开启分片。"

edits.before: "A first result must arrive before expiry; a later duplicate only acknowledges the existing result."
edits.after: "首次结果必须在到期前到达，稍后的相同副本只确认已有结果。"

edits.before: "Current owner is new at v2, expiry 120. Identity, result equality and first-completion time have separate roles."
edits.after: "当前持有者为 new，版本 v2，到期时间 120。身份、结果相等性与首次完成时间分别承担不同职责。"
"版本令牌拒绝：持有者或版本错误"
"计算有并发上限的工作批次"

edits.before: "At most the configured number of pool callbacks launch a child process at once."
edits.after: "同时启动子进程的工作池回调数，不超过配置的上限。"

edits.before: "Each child claims one persisted shard, compares recorded answers and submits a fenced receipt."
edits.after: "每个子进程领取一个持久化分片，比较已记录答案，并提交带版本令牌校验的凭据。"

edits.before: "The coordinator waits for the current wave before dispatching another; completed runs retain all receipts."
edits.after: "协调器等当前批次结束后才派发下一批，已完成运行保留所有凭据。"

edits.before: "A scheduling calculation with supplied shard durations. It estimates wave time, not measured model throughput."
edits.after: "根据给定分片时长进行调度计算；它估计批次用时，不表示测得的模型吞吐量。"
